references.title: DWDS: Murmeltier
references.supports: The Wortzerlegung 2Murmel Tier, for das Murmeltier; the Etymologie: from mlat. murem montis 'Bergmaus', leaned on murmeln by folk etymology and made clear by composition into murmelti(e)r (14th c.)

references.title: DWDS: Murmel
references.supports: 2Murmel, das, der, regional, Synonym zu Murmeltier; 1Murmel, die, is the glass marble

notes.rationale: The marmot, das Murmeltier. DWDS splits it Murmel + Tier, linking 2Murmel, a regional noun of its own for the animal, as Ren is in Rentier, so Murmel is a word, not a cranberry piece, and not die Murmel, the marble, a NOUN of another gender (ADR 0050). DWDS gives 2Murmel, the animal, das and der in one sense, so the part's Core gender is mixed Masc and Neut (de/noun-gender-in-free-variation; the round-5 judges agreed on #1241).
